map.二维码（QR Code）已经成为信息流转的通用入口。ToolBox 二维码生成器: QR codes have become the universal entry point for information exchange. The ToolBox QR code generator runs entirely locally in your browser: enter text, a URL, WiFi details or a contact card, and it generates a high-resolution QR code in real time and downloads it as PNG or SVG, with nothing uploaded to any server.

map.线下物料：菜单、桌牌、宣传单上的跳转入口: Offline materials: an entry point on menus, table cards and flyers

map.（可选）修改前景色/背景色，确保打印后对比度足够: (Optional) Adjust the foreground and background colors to ensure enough contrast after printing
map.纠错级别越高越耐脏污，但图案越密；户外物料建议 L/H 之间权衡: A higher error correction level tolerates more soiling but makes the pattern denser; for outdoor materials weigh L against H
map.打印二维码务必保留至少 4 个模块(静区)的空白边距，否则可能扫不出: When printing a QR code always keep at least 4 modules of blank margin (the quiet zone), otherwise it may not scan
map.深色前景 + 浅色背景对比度最高，避免相近色: A dark foreground with a light background gives the highest contrast; avoid similar colors
map.WiFi 二维码包含密码，注意只在可信环境分享: A WiFi QR code contains the password, so share it only in a trusted environment
map.二维码扫不出来怎么办？: What If the QR Code Won't Scan?
map.优先检查静区边距是否足够、对比度是否过低，以及纠错级别是否过低；重新生成并提高纠: First check whether the quiet zone margin is large enough, whether the contrast is too low and whether the error correction level is too low; regenerating at a higher error correction level usually solves it.
map.生成的二维码会被上传吗？: Will the Generated QR Code Be Uploaded?
